name: Dart pub workspaces
summary: Built-in Dart pub support for managing multiple packages in one repository with a shared dependency resolution.
advantages: Uses a shared dependency resolution across workspace packages
Can reduce analyzer memory usage for large repositories
tradeoffs: A single shared dependency resolution can surface dependency conflicts across packages
Does not replace higher-level monorepo scripting, release, and orchestration features
recommendedFor: Monorepos containing multiple Dart or Flutter packages
Teams that want one shared package resolution across workspace members
Repositories that want built-in workspace support without an additional orchestration tool

verification.reason: Dart official workspace documentation is sufficient for this first-pass entry.
